title: RELAYLOOP_MESSAGE v1 (normalized JSON form)
description: Normalized JSON representation of the RELAYLOOP_MESSAGE v1 text envelope. Every cross-Agent dispatch must carry these fields; Task and Acceptance are mandatory so the loop stays proof-gated.

from_role.description: Core roles: pm|dev|test|version|review|research|ux|fw|ml. Other values identify imported specialists.

response_to.description: A message_id, or the literal string 'none'.

acceptance.description: User-observable result, required commands/checks, required evidence, and how Test judges pass/fail.

return_format.description: Expected reply fields: Result, Summary, Evidence, Files changed, Commands run, Risks/blockers, Next recommended action.
